name: Field Trip to Hidden Villa Farms
description: Explore animal habitats, how animals adapt to their environment to survive and how they help it thrive. Parents: Return permission slip promptly. Sign up to chaperone on the Google Doc.

name: Valentine's Day Celebration
description: Parents: Bring 1 Valentine's card for all 22 friends in the class and leave the 'To:' section blank.

name: Sports-Themed Shirt Spirit Day
description: Parents: Send child in sports-themed shirt.

name: Label New Items
description: Parents: Please label new sweaters, clothes, and jackets with child's name. Also label any gloves/items brought to school.

name: PTA General Meeting
description: Join us for our next PTA meeting!

name: Yearbook Cover Contest (5th Graders Only)
description: Los Alamitos PTA is inviting all Los Alamitos 5th graders to enter their drawings in our Yearbook cover contest. 2 winners will be selected to be displayed on the front and back cover, by the Yearbook committee panel.

name: NOWRUZ (IRANIAN NEW YEAR) STAFF LUNCHEON
description: Please join us as we treat our staff to a delicious luncheon to celebrate the upcoming Iranian New Year and the first day of spring!

name: Variety Show – Volunteers & Important Info
description: We're gearing up for our upcoming Variety Show and need parent volunteers to help make it a success! Volunteer opportunities include Stage Hands and Concession Organizer. We are also looking for a volunteer who can provide a digital keyboard for the event. To Apply to the Variety Show, sign up with the link provided to showcase your talent.

name: Multicultural Fair
description: This year's Multicultural Fair, a beloved tradition at this school, invites you to share your culture with us, whether it's helping with your country's booth, fashion show, or with a group cultural performance.

name: Incoming 2025/26 Castillero 6th grade parents!
description: Castillero PTA is looking for incoming 6th grade parents to serve on the board. Castillero PTA funds and/ or runs events and programs like school dances, carnival, spirit wear, teacher and staff appreciation, and teacher grants.

name: Reading Lab Volunteers Needed!
description: The Reading Lab is a tutoring program for students who would benefit from extra help with fundamental reading skills. We are looking for volunteers who can come in once per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday) during the school year. Training for new tutors is provided!!

name: Yearbook
description: We are looking for photos from PTA events this year! If you have photos from various events, please upload them to the Google Drive Folders provided. Order your 2025–26 Yearbook today and save all the memories. Last day to order is 4/20.
